author: current Codex assistant
reasoning: Sweep columns, storing for each row how many current/future columns are already erased by selected squares. Whenever a current star is uncovered, branch over every square size and vertical placement covering it; each choice strictly reduces the number of uncovered current stars. Memoized transitions then advance one column. A square may be postponed to its leftmost still-needed column without hurting earlier coverage; near the right edge it is placed flush with the board edge, and excess tracked coverage is ignored after the final column. Since n>=4, every size remains physically placeable.
